plus.positioning: ChatGPT Plus provides broader model and tool access than Free, with higher model limits and advanced reasoning access. Exact model availability and usage limits can change over time.

go.official_reference: Check OpenAI's current pricing page for the country and currency shown to the buyer
go.positioning: ChatGPT Go is a lower-cost individual plan with expanded access to popular ChatGPT tools compared with Free. OpenAI says pricing can vary by country and currency and can change over time.

pro.positioning: OpenAI currently documents two ChatGPT Pro tiers. The $100 tier has 5x higher usage than Plus and the $200 tier has 20x higher usage than Plus; model-specific allowances can still apply.

business.official_reference: Standard: $25/user monthly or $20/user/month billed annually; Premium: $125/user monthly or $100/user/month billed annually
business.positioning: ChatGPT Business is a team workspace with centralized billing and admin controls. OpenAI currently requires at least two paid seats, which can be Standard, Premium, or a mix.

account_policy.statement: OpenAI says an account is meant for the individual who created it and another person should create their own account.

local_payment.rule: These are AI Premium Shop public payment references, not a claim about payment methods accepted directly by OpenAI.
